questions.stem_text: What is the biggest cause of death in children under five years old (as of 2017)?
questions.answer_explanation: Lower respiratory infections are the leading cause of mortality in children under five years old due to their high prevalence in low-income regions, where access to healthcare and preventive measures is limited, contributing to significant morbidity and mortality rates in this age group.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following mental disorders is most prevalent in the world?
questions.answer_explanation: Anxiety disorders are the most prevalent mental disorders globally, affecting a significant portion of the population due to their high incidence and widespread impact on daily functioning and quality of life.
